entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Prateek Mishra,Siddhartha Baghel
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 892 of 2020, registered under Sections 420, 406 I.P.C., Police Station Kotwali, Orai, District Jalaun during pendency of the trial.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case due to ulterior motive.

Allegation in FIR is that applicant and other co-accused opened co-operative society in the name and style of Sahaj Argo Purpose Co-operative Society Ltd. in which applicant was appointed as General Manager.

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:

1 have been given.

entities.text: Satish Mishra vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the company, co-accused, namely, Rashmi Rajauria, was designated as Vice President, who has been granted bail by this Court vide order dated 21.11.2022.
Applicant implicated in various similar type of cases, in seven case he has been granted bail.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 27.09.2022.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer of the applicant.

5. Considering the material available on record and keeping in view the nature of the offence,
argument advanced on behalf of the parties, evidence on record regarding complicity of the accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant, Satish Mishra, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
ii. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
iii. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
